body_markdown:
Today, we announced our second quarter financial results, marking our 15th consecutive quarter of net sales growth. Strong performance across our global brands and regions drove record sales in the quarter and a strong first half of the year. As a result, we are raising our full-year net sales outlook and increasing our expectations for the bottom line, positioning A&F Co. for another year of consistent, profitable performance in 2026.


[Read more about our Q2 2026 Earnings Results](https://wwd.com/business-news/retail/abercrombie-fitch-q2-shares-skyrocket-ceo-interview-1239164095/)
